# Independent full-entry audit

Approved all three entries with two narrow Python recovery additions. The source must be replayable or reliably staged, and manifest publication must reject stale job generations. Preserved profile timer/benchmark distinctions, itertools adjacent grouping, native memory and bincount allocation boundaries, finite category domain, event count versus distinct people, weighted means, GIL version qualifications, signing expiry/nonce retention and same-operation/new-nonce retry identity.

Coverage and evidence
- Frozen author manifest and every listed file verified before composition. Original scalar guards match the catalog-selected frozen baseline, and every whole entry reconciled equal to the current catalog-selected chunk. Earlier preflight drift is preserved in the author input receipt.
- Complete original-to-composed changes are in original-composed-full-diff.json. Original full spans are preserved in input/all-html-span-retention.json and checked against the actual original offsets. Ordered authored-to-composed spans are independently verified in ordered-composed-span-retention.json; all narrowing changes are enumerated.
- Actual compiled renderQA/renderDoc, card/list helpers, pager, relatedLinks, qAnchor/qKey/href, learning-order builder and its registry were executed in a bounded Node VM. Actual parseHash resolved every rendered entry route and own question anchor. Full rendered outputs are retained. Header, progress, comparison-card decoration and section wrappers are stubbed; this is markup/route QA, not browser layout or live integration acceptance.
- No live files edited, builds, JVM processes, external systems, authentication changes, Git pushes or Feishu writes.
- Independent primary-source openings are separately identified; inherited sources and pinned source claims are not silently upgraded to independently verified deployment evidence.

Integration
Use approved-leaves.json as ORIGINAL-before alternatives, not sequential patches on top of the author leaves. Recheck whole-entry guards and actual live catalog before applying. Integrated rendering and browser acceptance remain the integrator responsibility. This directory is immutable after frozen-manifest.json creation; further changes require a new addendum.
